name: Iris Murdoch
shortBio: Irish-British moral philosopher and novelist of the Oxford quartet (alongside Anscombe and Foot) who challenged existentialist and behaviorist voluntarism with a Platonic ethics of loving attention and 'unselfing'.
centralQuestion: Why does moral life depend less on isolated moments of autonomous choice than on the patient, selfless discipline of loving attention to reality?

keyWorks.title: The Sovereignty of Good
keyWorks.description: Seminal defense of moral realism, Platonic Good, and 'unselfing' through attentive perception of art, nature, and other persons.

keyWorks.title: Metaphysics as a Guide to Morals
keyWorks.description: Wide-ranging meditation uniting Plato, Kant, Wittgenstein, and Weil to defend moral consciousness against reductive structuralism.
